### Yesterday
Author: Oswald Chambers
Site: My Utmost for His Highest
URL: https://utmost.org/modern-classic/yesterday/
Passage: Isaiah 52:12
Points:
- Remembering past failures often stirs up anxiety, but God redeems past blunders to serve future ministry.
- God goes ahead into areas where we stumble, acting as a guard against repeated missteps.
- Because the Lord surrounds believers as both vanguard and rear guard, they need not advance in panic or impulsive haste.
- Entrusting the irreparable past to Christ allows believers to move steadily into the future with Him.
